items.en: The Western Gate is located at the southernmost end of the central axis of the Garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion and is the main gate of the garden. Official sources state that the gate is built of carved white marble and is a Western Rococo-style carved stone arched gate, incorporating such decorative elements as classical orders, arches, a raised top, shells, and reliefs of Western floral sprays. The outer side of the gate lintel is carved with “静含太古,” and the inner side with “秀挹恒春.” The line-method walls on both sides of the gate also bear finely executed reliefs, demonstrating a combination of Western forms and local cultural decoration.

The Rear Cover Building is located at the boundary between the residence and garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion and is a two-story building extending from east to west. Official sources state that it is approximately 151 meters long from east to west and 25 meters wide from north to south, with 116 rooms, commonly known as “99 and a half rooms.” Its eastern, central, and western sections are respectively named Zhanji Tower, Fujing Tower, and Baoyue Tower. Passages to the rear garden are located on both sides of the central section. At the westernmost end, there was once an indoor garden called the Waterworks Building, containing flowing springs, rockeries, and pavilions; remains of the indoor garden survive.

Yin’an Hall is the main hall on the central axis of Prince Gong’s Mansion. It is five bays wide and covered with green glazed tiles. In front are a moon platform, symmetrical stepped side approaches to the east and west, and lamp columns; subsidiary halls stand on both sides of the platform. The official website states that it was first built during the period of the Gurun Princess. The original building and the eastern and western subsidiary halls were destroyed by fire on the night of the Lantern Festival in 1920. The present buildings were reconstructed in 2008 according to the layout of the period of Prince Gong. The original text also records that the hall originally contained the prince’s throne and was used for ceremonies, rituals, governmental affairs, and sacrificial activities at the residence.

Jiale Hall is located in the fourth courtyard of the central axis of the residence of Prince Gong’s Mansion. It is the bedchamber behind Yin’an Hall and the last main hall on the central axis. The main hall is five bays wide, with a flush-gable roof and a front corridor, and is covered with green glazed tiles; subsidiary halls are located to the east and west. The official website states that it was first built during the period of the Gurun Princess and was originally a place for Shamanist sacrificial ceremonies, hence its other name, “Divine Hall.” The hall once contained a stove, a large cauldron, and a “wanzi kang,” used for cooking sacrificial offerings and distributing the food after the rituals. The eastern subsidiary hall once stored ritual vessels, while the western subsidiary hall once housed sacrificial livestock. Remains related to the rituals are also preserved in the courtyard.

Baoguang Room is located in the third courtyard of the western section of the residence of Prince Gong’s Mansion. The courtyard is relatively small, with a five-bay main hall and three side rooms on each of the east and west sides. The official website states that it was first built during the period of the Princess’s Residence, and that Heshen once entertained close relatives and friends here. During the period of Prince Gong, the Xianfeng Emperor bestowed the name “Baoguang Room” and explained its meaning as “concealing one’s brilliance and not letting others know,” carrying an admonition for Yixin to restrain his talents and abilities. After Yixin died of illness in 1898, Empress Dowager Cixi and the Guangxu Emperor discussed and settled various funeral arrangements with relevant ministers here.

Xijin Studio is located in the fourth courtyard of the western section of the residence of Prince Gong’s Mansion and was first built during the period of the Princess’s Residence. The official website states that during the period of Prince Qing it was called Qingyi Hall; during the period of the Junior Prince Gong, Puwei, it was renamed with its present name because it housed the Jin-dynasty Lu Ji’s handwritten copy of the “Pingfu Tie.” The main hall is seven bays wide, with corridors at the front and rear and a hip-and-gable-roofed baoxia at the rear eaves. Inside are a three-bay open hall and three-sided, two-story “immortal towers.” Components of golden-thread nanmu, nanmu partitions, and polychrome painted ceilings were used, and the layout is said to imitate the Palace of Tranquil Longevity. The eastern and western side rooms are respectively Legu Studio and Er’er Studio.

Duofu Studio is located in the third courtyard of the eastern section of the residence of Prince Gong’s Mansion. The main hall is five bays wide and covered with gray tubular tiles, with side rooms to the east and west. Inside the hall hangs a plaque reading “同德延釐,” bestowed by Empress Dowager Cixi for Prince Gong Yixin’s fiftieth birthday. Square calligraphic panels bearing the characters “福” and “寿” are displayed above the four walls, and a large nanmu bookcase is set against the north wall. The painted ceiling features magnolias and crabapple blossoms. The official website states that remnants of Qianlong-period phoenix-and-seal polychrome painting remain on the beams. A wisteria over one hundred years old stands in the courtyard in front of the hall, and the courtyard is therefore also called the “Wisteria Courtyard.”

Ledaotang is located in the fourth courtyard of the eastern section of the residence of Prince Gong’s Mansion. On the ridge purlin of the central bay of the northern roll-roofed section of the main hall are reverse-mounted baofu phoenix-and-seal polychrome paintings; the principal motifs are a spreading-winged golden phoenix, peonies, and auspicious clouds. The official website states that after the Gurun Heke Princess married, she lived in this courtyard for ten years, when it was called Yanxi Hall. In the thirtieth year of the Daoguang reign, after Yixin was granted Prince Qing’s Mansion, he renamed it Ledaotang. “Ledaotang” is said to have been inscribed by the Daoguang Emperor for Yixin before his wedding; he also bestowed a plaque and couplets expressing good wishes. Yixin later used this name for the main halls of several of his residences.

The Arrow Path is a broad roadway paved with gray bricks between the rear-eave wall of the Rear Cover Building of Prince Gong’s Mansion and the garden. The official website states that it is nearly 200 meters long. In addition to serving as a daily passageway, it was historically used by the prince and his sons and younger male relatives for practicing horseback riding and archery. The sources provided mainly describe its location, material, dimensions, and historical use, without further information on surviving features along the roadway, its construction date, or its architectural structure.

Dule Peak is located in the central section of the garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion, north of the Western Gate. It is an approximately five-meter-high solitary ornamental rock of northern Taihu stone. The official website states that it was placed near the garden entrance both to embellish the landscape and block the view, while also serving as a screen wall and screen. Natural textures formed through years of weathering cover the stone; the original text compares its form to a whirlpool in soft water or thin clouds unfurling. When viewed from below, the two characters “乐峰” can be seen, while the character “独” is hidden at the top of the stone, creating a visual play on its name.

The Bat Pond is located in the central section of the garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion, north of Dule Peak. It is a pond enclosed with bluestone. Its former name was the “Bat River,” later changed to “Bat Pond”; the name derives from the pond’s resemblance to a bat. Elm trees grow beside the pond. In late spring, elm samaras fall into the pond, and because they resemble copper coins, they were imbued with the auspicious meaning of “an abundance of blessings and wealth,” expressing the wish for both good fortune and prosperity.

Dihua Studio is located in the central section of the garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion, east of the Bat Pond. It was named after the plaque inscribed by the Xianfeng Emperor in his own hand with “棣华轩.” The official website connects its name with the experiences of Yizhu and Yixin practicing spear and saber techniques in their youth: the Daoguang Emperor bestowed the name “Dihua United Effort” on the spear technique and “Treasure Edge Proclaiming Might” on the saber technique, expressing his hope that the brothers would work together. The sources thus present the courtly familial implications carried by the name Dihua Studio.

Anshan Hall is located in the central section of the garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion and is a five-bay hall. Its main structure consists of a building with two linked hip-and-gable-roofed sections; a three-bay flush-gable-roofed baoxia is attached to the south, and covered walkways connect the east and west sides. The name derives from a plaque inscribed by the Xianfeng Emperor in his own hand. In terms of historical use, it was originally a place where the owner composed poetry and painted while visiting the garden; during the period of Prince Gong Yixin, it was also used to entertain important guests.

Dicu Rock is an artificial hill formed by stacking Taihu stones, located north of Anshan Hall in the central section of the garden of Prince Gong’s Mansion. Miyun Cave is concealed within the body of the artificial hill and contains a “福” character stele written by the Kangxi Emperor in his own hand. The top of Dicu Rock is the highest point in the garden, with the “Green Heaven Little Hermitage” and Moon-Inviting Terrace located there. According to the official website, the name is related to moss among the rocks: in the past, after water was stored, emerald-green moss grew on the rock walls in summer and autumn, forming a scene of yellow stone and green moss, lush and dripping with verdure.

组内代表性最高：以“积水潭”身份承载元大都漕运终点及汇通祠小岛等独特历史文化线索，非其他水域可替代。
组内居中：后海具有元代城市活动区和近现代休憩水域的代表性，但与什刹海整体及其他水域的功能景观重复较多。
组内相对靠后：前海以荷花、潭苑水院等整治后景观见长，观赏价值明确，但历史与叙事特征较多可由什刹海整体及其他水域覆盖。
组内相对代表性第二：虽承接什刹海沿岸历史市集并体现当代商业复兴，但其商业街区特征与烟袋斜街存在较大同类重叠，独特性较弱。
组内首位：兼具元代街巷源流、传统市井商业和现存步行街形态，是本组最具历史连续性与商业街代表性的节点。
组内唯一的传统四合院建筑节点，虽缺少明确名人或重大历史事件关联，但以正式文保身份和较完整院落规模代表南锣鼓巷普通传统居住建筑类型。
组内唯一对象，兼具清代大学士宅第与仿江南名园的宅园复合代表性，非重复性最高。
组内综合代表性最高，兼具较长历史沿革、湖岸区位、寺观与名人旧居等复合价值。
组内传统名人宅院与园林信息最集中，历史建筑代表性仅次于鸦儿胡同。

组内兼具完整街巷风貌、齐白石旧居及公共更新节点，综合代表性位居前列。
组内拥有茅盾故居和蒋介石行辕等多重近现代史节点，独特性仅低于前列对象。
组内以僧格林沁王府及祠堂关联形成鲜明王府叙事，代表性位居中上。
组内有洪承畴、奎俊宅址等历史人物线索，独特性明显高于一般支巷。
组内以中央戏剧学院及靳云鹏旧宅变迁补充近现代城市更新叙事，处于中游。
组内属于保留传统肌理并完成修缮的支巷，但专属历史节点较少，代表性居中。
组内同样体现传统胡同修缮与居民共生，但缺少突出的专属历史节点，略低于蓑衣胡同。

组内综合代表性最高：元代古刹兼具藏经、佛教教育与京师图书馆沿革，宗教建筑叙事最完整。
组内第二：历史年代与道教正一派名观地位突出，琉璃建筑群和祈火叙事具有较强独特性。
组内第三：明代宫观遗存与什刹海文化展示功能结合，在道教节点中代表性较强且承担区域历史补位。
组内第四：晚清王府祭祀建筑转为关岳庙，身份变迁独特，但历史层级和现存叙事完整度低于前三者。
组内第五：作为德胜桥‘一桥两庙’的一员有景观补位价值，但现阶段修缮与活化尚未形成成熟参观内容。
组内第六：与真武庙共同构成桥庙景观但自身辨识度较弱，且仍处于活化利用规划阶段，重复性最高。
组内唯一对象，作为保存元代里坊制胡同肌理并汇聚多时期院落与街巷文化的整体街区，代表性与不可替代性最高。
组内唯一对象，作为涵盖三海水系、元大都漕运源流及沿岸历史聚落的风景区整体，代表性与补位价值均居首。
组内代表性最高：兼具中轴线、大运河玉河故道、澄清上闸及元代遗存等复合价值，是历史桥梁与水工节点的核心样本。
组内居中：明代闸桥合一石拱桥，历史沿革较完整，但整体叙事与遗产层级不及万宁桥，独特性次之。
组内相对末位：主要价值在银锭观山景观视廊和游览体验，桥体历史与水工信息较少，作为桥梁遗产的独特性低于前两者。
组内综合代表性最高之一，以郭守敬科学、水利与元大都城市文明叙事形成最鲜明的独特补位。
组内排名前列，兼具清代王府花园遗产与宋庆龄生平，是近现代国家叙事的重要代表。
组内品质与人物地位最高一档，以梅派京剧和完整故居纪念馆体系形成突出代表性。
组内排名前列，是唯一集中呈现元代科学家、城市水利与天文历法关联的纪念节点。
组内中上位，故居原状与文学家晚年创作结合紧密，但与其他名人故居类型存在一定重复。
组内中上位，以艺术大师晚年居住创作及复原陈列见长，代表性高于一般宅院节点。
组内中上位，末代皇后娘家与清末宫廷女性史补位鲜明，但当前主要可见外部与院门。
组内中位偏后，以作家长期居住创作和西式小楼形态具有特色，但现状展示性弱于正式纪念馆。
组内后段，明末降清人物的历史转折价值较突出，但建筑保存、现状与参观信息不足。
组内后段，清代高官宅邸身份提供有限历史补位，现存性与可识别性不如前列节点。
组内后段，仅凭历史宅主归属形成一般性补位，与同类宅院节点重复度较高。
组内代表性最低一档，宅院组归属虽有历史价值，但对象边界、保存状况与独特展示内容均较弱。
组内唯一的城门与城防建筑节点，明清内城城防实物代表性突出，且为什刹海北缘补足都城防御与城市格局叙事。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府中兼具日常通行与王府子弟跑马射箭历史用途的长条交通活动空间，代表性较高且重复性低。
组内代表性最高，清代全封闭大戏楼极为罕见，并以王府戏曲与声学空间补足花园叙事。
组内第二，凭超常规模、王府格局及室内花园遗迹的稀有性，补足府园居住与空间组织叙事。
组内第三，是恭王府中西合璧门庭的典范，但在核心建筑代表性上略低于大戏楼和后罩楼。
组内第四，虽为花园中路主要厅堂并承载宴游功能，但与其他园林厅堂存在较明显重复。
组内代表性最低，主要价值集中于御书匾额和兄弟故事，建筑形制及独特空间信息相对有限。
组内代表性最高的一线核心正殿，虽为重建但府邸礼制与整体叙事不可替代。
组内独特性仅次于锡晋斋，以满族萨满祭祀功能及遗存形成鲜明的非重复节点。
组内属中上位置，历史政治事件价值突出，但建筑形制与展示独特性不及核心正殿。
组内品质与独特性最高，兼具僭侈建筑、仿宁寿宫格局、金丝楠木构件及《平复帖》收藏叙事。
组内偏后，虽有慈禧御匾、凤和玺彩画和古藤萝，但主题仍较集中于吉祥装饰与庭院观赏。
组内代表性相对较低，名称沿革和公主、恭亲王居住史有价值，但与其他正厅的建筑展示重复度较高。
组内唯一对象，作为康熙御笔榜书与碑刻实物兼具皇家题刻、独特字形寓意和恭王府花园核心文化标识，代表性最高。
组内唯一对象，兼具恭王府花园制高点、太湖石叠山、秘云洞及康熙御笔“福”字碑等复合代表性，因而品质与非重复性均居高位。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府花园入口兼具孤赏石、影壁与屏风功能，形制和题字趣味突出，代表性最高。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府花园整体代表清代王府园林与府邸互补的完整叙事环节，独特性与补位价值均高。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府花园中具有蝙蝠形制与“福钱”寓意的水体节点，独特性高但品质与叙事补位属局部。
组内唯一对象，作为万宁桥现存组合镇水石刻中明确可认定的一件元代石雕，具有较高的桥梁附属石刻代表性与叙事补位价值。
组内唯一对象，且为北京现存保存最完整并开放参观的清代王府及花园整体，在清代王府建筑、府园格局与晚清历史叙事中均具不可替代的代表性。

missing.zh: 缺僧王府现状是否对外开放、游客能否入内参观，还是仅能在外围看到保护范围内的围墙。现有官方资料（文物局公示）只给出保护范围四至与围墙现状，另一份旧文也只记载历史格局，均未说明当前可否进入、能看到哪些实物。若该址实际为居民合用的生活空间、完全不对外开放，专程前往的参观价值会明显降低，这与简介和定级隐含的'可参观王府遗址'印象相反。

results.cr_reason: 组内代表性最高：兼具清代王府完整格局、溥仪出生这一重大历史节点及宋庆龄故居的时代叠加，独特性最强。
组内代表性第二：府址规模大、跨多条胡同且与僧格林沁相关，南锣鼓巷王府叙事中的辨识度较高。
组内代表性第三：保存较完整的西部生活区有价值，但主体拆改且历史定位与醇、恭等王府相比更具重复性。
组内代表性最低：兼有愉王府旧址和涛贝勒府沿革，但拆改严重、现存格局不完整，独特补位价值弱于组内其他三项。
组内唯一对象，兼具西海湿地生态景观与元代大运河北端码头、郭守敬纪念关联，代表性与非重复性最高。
组内唯一的王府附属祠堂遗址，且祠堂与王府同胡同的布局被称为北京孤例，代表性和非重复性最高；但现存状况与开放性未明，叙事补位价值中上。
组内唯一对象，作为吴良镛主持的胡同有机更新代表项目，在现代遗产与居住型城市更新叙事中具有最高且不可替代的代表性。
组内唯一对象，作为蒋介石北平行辕这一近代政治人物历史旧址节点，代表性和非重复性最高，并补足北平政局与国共历史叙事。
组内唯一的近代高等教育旧址，兼具中西合璧校园建筑、天主教办学与高校制度变迁价值，代表性最高且无同类重复。
组内唯一对象，兼具中轴线北端标志性建筑群、元明清报时中心与钟鼓实物等复合代表性，因而三项均取高分。
组内综合代表性居次：虽为北京中轴线北端标志性报时楼阁且保留鼓楼报时传统，但相较钟楼的永乐大钟，其独特实物识别度略弱。
组内首位：现存清代砖石钟楼与永乐年制、重约63吨的古铜钟构成不可替代的报时遗产组合，在建筑群及中轴线叙事中最具代表性。
组内代表性最高：明永乐原铸、体量与历史地位突出，是北京传统报时体系中不可替代的核心实物。
组内次位：仅存一面原主鼓且其余为复制品，实物完整性和独特性低于永乐铜钟，但能补足鼓楼报时体系的另一端。

results.sness_reason: S：整体街区是本区域历史胡同肌理与活态城市遗产的核心，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，整体消失会直接损害馆区身份。
S：恭王府及花园是保存完整的清代王府整体，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，整体消失会显著削弱本区域的清代王府识别度。
S：钟鼓楼整体是中轴线北端及古都报时制度的标志，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，建筑群消失会明显损害馆区身份。
S：鼓楼本身是北京标志性建筑，短访仍值得安排，错过会明显可惜；但钟楼及钟鼓楼整体仍在，单体并非唯一身份支点。
S：钟楼兼具中轴线标志与独特建筑价值，短访仍应安排，错过明显可惜；但严格看其身份作用与鼓楼及建筑群重叠，单体消失不单独决定馆区身份。
S：明永乐报时铜钟体量、年代和历史功能均极为独特，短访参观钟楼时应确保看到；错过明显可惜，失去这一标志性实物会明显损害钟楼的核心识别度。
S：花园是恭王府不可替代的一半，且具有独立完整的园林价值，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，花园消失会明显损害恭王府整体身份。
A：虽为府邸正殿，但现建筑为2008年重建，通常只能作外观节点；两小时内不必为其单独优先安排，错过不构成明显遗憾，且其他府邸与花园仍保留整体身份。
A：锡晋斋有精美构件和和珅史迹，但仍是府邸众多重要建筑中的一个；两小时内不属必须优先节点，错过不至于明显可惜，消失也不会单独改变恭王府身份。
S：滴翠岩制高点、秘云洞及康熙御笔福字碑构成花园的突出看点，短访仍应安排，错过明显可惜；但它只是花园中的一个节点，不能单独代表整体身份。

坚持传统的炭火铜锅、清汤涮肉的鸦儿李记

items.description: 护国寺小吃（地安门店）在点评平台会员相册页面中以该分店名称单独列示，页面归入北京小吃快餐类别，并显示该店的人均价格快照为28元。页面还明确标注了本店的地址信息，但未提供电话，更多环境、交通和优惠内容需进入商户页面查看。本条仅据该平台索引整理分店身份及快照信息，未取得本店完整实时菜单，因此不将护国寺总店、新街口店或其他分店的菜品、历史和经营情况移入本店。
items.editor_note: 资料仅为平台会员相册/商户索引快照；人均价格不是当前消费承诺，也不是官方认定。页面未提供本店营业时间，当前是否营业仍待核实。

items.description: 大清邮政信柜（什刹海邮政所）是烟袋斜街53号的主题邮局分店。政府报道记载，其前身隶属于地安门邮政局什刹海邮电所，2011年以“大清邮政信柜”名义开门营业；2021年报道又称其经过装修升级后重新开业。报道介绍的店内内容包括大龙邮票、蟠龙邮票、费拉尔手稿等展陈，以及古法凸版印刷机明信片体验和邮品、明信片销售。报道还说明，该名称是为配合烟袋斜街文化展示而命名，不能据此认定为清代原建邮局。
items.editor_note: 依据为2021年政府报道，所述“重新对外开放”、体验项目和展陈属于报道当时信息，不能推断当前仍开放或项目仍在。2011年开业是该主题邮局经营起点，不是清代建筑年代。

evidence.quote: 2011年，位于烟袋斜街的“大清邮政信柜”开门营业
为配合烟袋斜街展现老北京文化、展示北京邮政的悠久历史，才以“大清邮政信柜”命名

items.description: 富华斋饽饽铺（护国新天地店）在点评搜索索引中以独立分店名称出现，页面将其标为“宫廷糕点·伴手礼”类商户，并显示人均价格快照为56元。索引同时给出其位于护国新天地商场一楼底商的门店识别信息。当前所取得的材料只有点评索引摘录，没有详情正文、实时菜单、营业时间或历史资料，因此只能确认平台上的分店条目，不能把“宫廷糕点”作为历史身份认证，也不能据此判断当天营业。
items.editor_note: 资料取得方式为平台搜索索引摘录，信息非常有限；人均56元为页面快照，不代表当前价格。未取得本店完整菜单、评价详情或官方历史说明。

results.peer_group: 北京历史文化街区整体
results.evidence: 保存元大都里坊—胡同院落肌理并叠加明清至当代生活与商业层次，是南锣鼓巷片区最核心的整体遗产体验。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 修缮保留了胡同肌理和院落风貌，并改善了居民生活环境，但缺少本巷独有历史节点的充分资料。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 作为传统支巷，修缮后仍保存胡同与院落风貌，但现有资料未显示其具有突出的专属历史节点。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 除保存传统胡同风貌外，还关联清代值年旗衙门遗存、公共展陈空间及齐白石旧居，叙事层次较丰富。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 保留数百年街巷风貌并集中关联可园、婉容娘家等重要宅院，名人、园林与晚清城市生活叙事突出。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 目前仅能确认其为南锣鼓巷西侧传统支巷，缺乏本巷独有沿革、建筑和开放信息。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 目前资料只确认其属于南锣鼓巷传统支巷体系，未提供足以形成独立参观重点的专属遗产信息。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 传统街巷风貌与洪承畴、奎俊等历史宅址及近现代商业生活并存，具有一定人物史和日常生活叙事。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 现有材料仅提供其在支巷序列中的位置，未说明独特沿革、建筑遗存或可进入的参观节点。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 清代僧格林沁王府及其祠堂的历史关联赋予胡同较强的政治军事与王府制度叙事，但现状开放不明。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 板厂胡同因僧格林沁王府后门具有局部历史关联，但资料不足以证明整条胡同仍保存突出遗存。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统胡同支巷
results.evidence: 中央戏剧学院及靳云鹏旧宅的历史关联增加了近代城市史价值，但相关旧建筑已拆除且校园内部开放情况不明。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷支巷
results.evidence: 仅能确认其为南锣鼓巷东侧支巷，缺乏专属历史、建筑遗存和参观亮点资料，因而按普通传统胡同节点评估。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷支巷
results.evidence: 作为南锣鼓巷传统支巷具有一般历史街区价值，且有35号清内务府总管大臣索宅的历史关联，但不能将单一院址价值外推为全巷。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷支巷
results.evidence: 现有资料仅确认其为南锣鼓巷东侧支巷，未提供独立沿革、格局、建筑或开放信息。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷支巷
results.evidence: 街巷内集中关联茅盾故居和蒋介石北平行辕等近现代历史地点，兼具传统胡同环境与可识别的人物叙事，但整巷开放和保存状况不明。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷支巷
results.evidence: 明代以来的名称沿革与吴良镛主持的有机更新工程相结合，并获亚洲建筑金奖和世界人居奖，能清晰呈现传统居住区保护与现代更新议题。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷清代王府建筑
results.evidence: 僧王府是跨多条胡同的大型清代亲王府址，保护范围明确，具有较强的王府制度、晚清政治与城市格局叙事价值，但室内开放未核实。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷清代王府附属遗址
results.evidence: 资料确认其为僧格林沁家族祠堂并与僧王府形成特殊布局，但缺乏独立文保身份、现存状况和开放信息。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷清代宅园
results.evidence: 可园及文煜宅是清代大学士宅院与仿江南名园的组合，官方保护范围明确，兼具晚清宅园艺术、人物史和中外使用沿革价值，但内部开放未核实。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷名人故居与纪念馆
results.evidence: 婉容出生及册后修建使该宅院具有清末皇室与近代社会史意义，并列为文物保护单位，但目前主要可见外部和院门，现场体验受限。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷名人故居与纪念馆
results.evidence: 齐白石晚年居住、创作及复原陈列集中于清中期四合院内，能同时解释艺术家生涯、北京居住文化与晚年创作，具明确纪念馆属性。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷名人故居与纪念馆
results.evidence: 茅盾晚年居所和原状起居空间保存较好，并展出书籍、用品及文具等资料，具有重要现代文学史和作家生活史叙事价值。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷近代政治人物历史旧址
results.evidence: 该宅院兼具清宗室宅第与1945至1949年蒋介石北平行辕两重历史身份，政治史价值明确，但现状保存和公众参观条件未核实。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷历史名人宅院（现址）
results.evidence: 现有材料仅能确认其属于荣禄之父宅邸的一部分，建筑保存、格局与开放状态均未核实，现场体验和叙事价值有限。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷历史名人宅院（现址）
results.evidence: 索家宅院的清代官员宅主身份有文旅资料支持，但缺乏建筑沿革、保存状况和可参观性信息。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷历史名人宅院（现址）
results.evidence: 奎俊作为清代刑部尚书具有一定历史叙事价值，但现有资料未证明宅院遗存、建筑特色或开放条件。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷历史名人宅院（现址）
results.evidence: 洪承畴与明清易代相关，历史人物叙事较强，但“洪承畴宅”仅据文旅旧文，现存性和现场体验均未核实。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统四合院文保建筑
results.evidence: 该院落有北京市文物保护单位身份、约3000平方米规模和传统四合院形制，但资料未说明当前状态及室内开放。

results.peer_group: 北京胡同有机更新项目
results.evidence: 吴良镛主持的有机更新项目兼具国际建筑奖项、胡同风貌延续和现代居住实践价值，但属于居民区而非完整古建开放点。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷历史名人宅址（原址）
results.evidence: 靳云鹏旧宅的历史沿革有资料记载，但原有建筑已全部拆除，现为校园且无旧宅遗迹，现场可读性很弱。

results.peer_group: 什刹海历史文化风景区整体
results.evidence: 什刹海兼具元大都水系与大运河漕运节点、历史保护区、连续水域景观和沿岸古迹民居等整体价值。

results.peer_group: 什刹海三海水域单元
results.evidence: 前海是元代城市水系和漕运体系的组成部分，兼有荷花、水岸及开放式游览景观，但其价值与什刹海整体高度重叠。

results.peer_group: 什刹海三海水域单元
results.evidence: 后海承载元代以来城市活动和水岸整治历史，环湖景观、步道与休憩体验突出，但独立历史边界和现行设施资料有限。

results.peer_group: 什刹海三海水域单元
results.evidence: 西海即积水潭，与元大都漕运及郭守敬水利体系联系紧密，历史教育价值较高，但现有材料对独立现状和设施保存说明不足。

results.peer_group: 什刹海桥梁与观景节点
results.evidence: 银锭桥及银锭观山视廊提供什刹海水面、垂柳与西山远眺的强烈现场体验，观山效果则受天气和能见度影响。

results.peer_group: 什刹海历史桥梁与水工节点
results.evidence: 明代始建的闸桥合一单孔石拱桥，具有桥梁、水利和城市沿革价值，但现状与开放信息不足。

results.peer_group: 什刹海历史桥梁与水工节点
results.evidence: 万宁桥兼具元代运河遗产、中轴线节点、澄清上闸和国家重点文物保护单位身份，是什刹海核心历史节点。

results.peer_group: 什刹海桥梁附属石刻
results.evidence: 六只镇水兽构成桥梁遗产的重要附属石刻，其中仅一只明确为元代石雕，年代和历史价值存在差异。

results.peer_group: 什刹海传统商业街区与市集
results.evidence: 承接什刹海荷花市集和城市商业记忆，当前以餐饮、生活和文创为主，历史遗存的独特性相对有限。

results.peer_group: 什刹海传统商业街区与市集
results.evidence: 元代形成、清末定名的短街仍保有传统商业和市井文化氛围，是什刹海最具游客辨识度的街巷之一。

results.peer_group: 什刹海历史宗教建筑
results.evidence: 明代道观保留山门、殿宇和白云仙院等格局，兼具文物建筑与什刹海文化展示中心功能。

results.peer_group: 什刹海历史宗教建筑
results.evidence: 具有长期道教沿革、皇家修建背景和多进殿楼格局，琉璃瓦建筑形象鲜明且曾修缮后开放。

results.peer_group: 什刹海历史宗教建筑
results.evidence: 元代寺院遗存与明清佛教建筑、藏经及近现代教育文化史叠加，历史层次和叙事价值突出，但部分区域已拆改。

results.peer_group: 什刹海人物纪念馆与故居
results.evidence: 以汇通祠为载体系统讲述郭守敬、元代积水潭、大都治水和测天制历，教育叙事强但建筑空间较小。

results.peer_group: 什刹海湖岸景观与生态空间
results.evidence: 西海沿岸湿地提供开阔水面、芦苇和水鸟景观，并连接元代漕运与郭守敬叙事，但自身历史遗产属性较弱。

results.peer_group: 什刹海现代人物纪念雕像
results.evidence: 雕像主要承担郭守敬及大运河水利功绩的当代纪念和识别功能，作者、年代、材质与尺度均未明确。

results.peer_group: 什刹海人物纪念馆与故居
results.evidence: 全国重点文物保护单位级别的真实故居，保留郭沫若晚年生活、写作环境及手稿文献等完整纪念叙事。

results.peer_group: 近现代名人故居纪念馆
results.evidence: 兼具清代王府花园遗存与宋庆龄长期居所的双重历史层次，是什刹海连接晚清王府史与现代中国政治文化史的重要节点；历史开放事实明确，但当前开放情况未核实。

results.peer_group: 清代王府及王府遗存
results.evidence: 这里是溥仪出生地和晚清摄政王府，府邸格局及主要建筑仍具解释力，但西花园已另作宋庆龄故居，其他部分开放情况未核实。

results.peer_group: 清代王府及王府遗存
results.evidence: 庆亲王府保存了较完整的西部生活区和多座厅堂，可说明晚清王府生活，但主要殿堂及东部已有改建且内部参观未核实。

results.peer_group: 清代王府及王府遗存
results.evidence: 涛贝勒府兼有清代王府、辅仁大学和近现代校园史，现存中路及东路部分院落仍有风貌，但整体拆改明显且不默认可入内。

results.peer_group: 近代高等教育旧址
results.evidence: 中西合璧主楼见证辅仁大学的创办及天主教高等教育在北京的发展，建筑尺度和礼堂空间有观赏性，但现为校园建筑、参观安排未核实。

results.peer_group: 历史商业与社交建筑
results.evidence: 会贤堂是北京八大堂之一，临水重楼、花园和戏台能够讲述晚清餐饮社交文化及辅仁大学后续使用，但现状和开放方式未确认。

results.peer_group: 什刹海宗教与祭祀建筑
results.evidence: 由醇贤亲王庙转为供奉关羽、岳飞的关岳庙，院落规制和身份变迁具有叙事价值，但年代较晚且当前入内安排未核实。

results.peer_group: 什刹海胡同街巷
results.evidence: 鸦儿胡同保留元明以来的名称沿革和后海沿岸城市肌理，串联广化寺、名人旧居与现代酒吧生活，是体验什刹海胡同环境的代表性公共空间。

results.peer_group: 明清北京城门与城防建筑
results.evidence: 德胜门箭楼是明代内城城防设施的高完整度实例，体量、绿琉璃屋顶和城门历史均有现场冲击力，但内部开放情况未核实。

results.peer_group: 近现代名人故居纪念馆
results.evidence: 梅兰芳故居保存四合院空间及缀玉轩，并作为正式纪念馆收藏大量戏曲资料，能集中呈现京剧艺术大师及梅派文化，官方博物馆资料明确记载开放。

results.peer_group: 清代王府及王府遗存
results.evidence: 恭王府及花园是北京保存最完整且向社会开放的清代王府建筑群之一，兼具和珅、庆王府、恭亲王府历史、府园格局和高密度标志性景观，是本区核心体验。

results.peer_group: 北京中轴线报时建筑群
results.evidence: 钟鼓楼作为元明清都城报时中心延续七百余年，拥有高耸楼体、巨型永乐铜钟和中轴线位置，兼具城市象征性、视觉冲击和都城制度解释力。

results.peer_group: 中轴线钟鼓楼建筑节点
results.evidence: 元明清延续的都城报时建筑，现存楼阁高大壮观，是北京中轴线北端和古都形象的重要标志。

results.peer_group: 中轴线钟鼓楼建筑节点
results.evidence: 清代现存钟楼结合元明历史、巨大永乐铜钟和独特砖石拱券结构，兼具国家级遗产意义与强烈现场冲击。

results.peer_group: 钟鼓楼报时器物
results.evidence: 明永乐年间铸造、重约63吨的报时铜钟，是钟楼身份核心和中国古代大型铜钟的代表性实物。

results.peer_group: 钟鼓楼报时器物
results.evidence: 残存主鼓保留了定更报时的实物联系，但多数为复制更鼓，整体展示价值明显低于钟楼和永乐铜钟。

results.peer_group: 什刹海文学名人故居
results.evidence: 小楼承载萧军长期创作及现代文学史记忆，但建筑规模有限、内部已搬空且当前公众进入安排不明。

results.peer_group: 什刹海沿岸寺观节点
results.evidence: 真武庙是德胜桥一桥两庙和西海东沿历史景观的重要组成，但目前主要处于保护修缮与活化规划阶段。

results.peer_group: 什刹海沿岸寺观节点
results.evidence: 永泉庵与德胜桥、真武庙共同构成沿岸历史节点，具有景观和宗教史价值，但现有资料不足且开放状态未明。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府园建筑节点
results.evidence: 恭王府保存最完整的王府园林部分，三路布局、福字碑和山水空间共同形成高辨识度的清代皇家贵族园林体验。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府园建筑节点
results.evidence: 清代少见的全封闭式大戏楼，建筑、声学、陈设和王府演剧制度叙事集中，属于恭王府代表性节点。

results.peer_group: 恭王府碑刻与题刻
results.evidence: 康熙御笔“福”字及其多重吉祥寓意使其成为恭王府最具传播力的文化符号，但碑体尺度和现场可见性有限。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府园建筑节点
results.evidence: 汉白玉洛可可式拱门融合西式装饰与传统题刻，并与大戏楼、后罩楼并列为恭王府“三绝”。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府园建筑节点
results.evidence: 横贯府园、长约151米的后罩楼规模罕见，兼具王府制度史、建筑规制和室内花园遗迹等多重叙事价值。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府邸核心正殿院落
results.evidence: 恭王府中路正殿，承载亲王府典礼、政务与祭祀功能，形制庄重但现建筑为2008年重建。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府邸核心正殿院落
results.evidence: 清代王府中罕见而叙事性强的萨满祭祀空间，保留祭祀遗存并能解释满族宗教实践。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府邸核心正殿院落
results.evidence: 兼具和珅、恭亲王及晚清宫廷政治事件记忆，但形制与现状资料较少，现场冲击力相对有限。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府邸核心正殿院落
results.evidence: 以《平复帖》收藏史和和珅僭侈建筑背景著称，金丝楠木、仙楼和彩绘构成府邸中最强的室内空间之一。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府邸核心正殿院落
results.evidence: 保存御书匾额、清代高等级彩画和楠木书架，藤萝庭院增强观赏性，但历史叙事集中于王府生活与吉祥文化。

results.peer_group: 恭王府府邸核心正殿院落
results.evidence: 具有公主居住、奕䜣家族生活及道光赐名等清代王府家族史价值，凤和玺彩画提供视觉亮点。

results.peer_group: 恭王府交通与活动空间
results.evidence: 近200米青砖通道兼具王府日常交通与跑马射箭功能，能补充贵族生活史，但自身遗存与视觉层次较有限。

results.peer_group: 恭王府花园太湖石山石
results.evidence: 约五米高的北太湖石兼具园林障景、影壁和题字趣味，是恭王府花园入口辨识度很高的单件山石。

results.peer_group: 恭王府花园水体与池塘节点
results.evidence: 青石围砌、蝙蝠形池名及榆钱寓意体现王府园林的象征性营造，但历史信息和空间规模相对有限。

results.peer_group: 恭王府花园园林建筑节点
results.evidence: 御书匾额及咸丰、恭亲王兄弟关系赋予其宫廷家族叙事，但建筑形制和现场体验资料不足。

results.peer_group: 恭王府花园园林建筑节点
results.evidence: 花园中路主要厅堂，形制宏整并承载御赐匾额、园游吟咏和恭亲王宴客等核心王府园林功能。

results.peer_group: 恭王府花园叠石与洞窟节点
results.evidence: 大型太湖石假山、制高点、秘云洞及康熙御笔福字碑构成兼具视觉地标和清代皇家园林文化叙事的复合节点。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷餐饮门店
results.evidence: 有南锣鼓巷游客记忆和传统甜品传述，但本店建筑、传承及当前经营均未得到可靠历史确认。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷餐饮门店
results.evidence: 炸酱面可联系北京日常饮食文化，店铺亦有一定游客知名度，但本店店史和建筑遗产价值未见证据。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷餐饮门店
results.evidence: 始于1992年并有“中戏第二食堂”的地方记忆，但现存房屋年代、保存状况和文化独特性不明。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷咖啡及休闲餐饮门店
results.evidence: 花园式空间和胡同环境具有较强现场吸引力，但其历史、艺术和遗产叙事证据很弱。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷咖啡及休闲餐饮门店
results.evidence: 现有资料仅能确认咖啡店平台分类、饮品和消费快照，未见历史建筑或文化主题依据。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷传统工艺及生活方式店铺
results.evidence: 扇子陈列、按器物尺度设计的展示空间具有传统工艺和生活方式解释价值，但资料仅反映2018年状态。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷文创及手账店
results.evidence: 手账用品和现场制作体现当代青年消费文化，商品陈列有吸引力，但历史遗产关联有限。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷新式文创店
results.evidence: 报道确认其为新开手作文创店并有特色门面和手作商品，但缺少店史、地址及持续经营证据。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷新式文创店
results.evidence: 陶瓷、剪纸、印章和手绘葫芦可承载传统工艺转译叙事，但未证明为非遗项目或稳定体验空间。

results.peer_group: 南锣鼓巷新式文创店
results.evidence: 巧克力制作天坛和长城造型具有明显新奇视觉与嗅觉吸引力，但属于现代创意商品而非遗产原件。

results.peer_group: 什刹海传统餐饮门店
results.evidence: 饭庄品牌可追溯至1848年，烤肉技艺获北京市非遗认定，并与银锭桥及什刹海景观形成强场所关联，但现楼是否原构未证实。

results.peer_group: 什刹海传统餐饮门店
results.evidence: 仅有平台地址、人均和菜品资料，虽位于银锭桥旁，但缺少可核实的店史、建筑年代及遗产叙事。

results.peer_group: 什刹海传统餐饮门店
results.evidence: 资料确认其为什刹海的现代清真餐饮门店，具有传统炭火铜锅涮肉和一定景观用餐吸引力，但无本店历史建筑或不可替代文化遗产依据。

results.peer_group: 护国寺街传统小吃门店
results.evidence: 现有资料只能确认地安门外大街的具体小吃分店及平台索引，未提供其历史、建筑特色或独特文化叙事。

results.peer_group: 北京历史主题邮局与邮政文化展示节点
results.evidence: 该节点依托什刹海历史街区和邮政所前身，通过邮票展陈、主题设计及古法凸版印刷体验讲述近代邮政文化，但本身是2011年形成的现代主题邮局而非清代原建遗址。

results.peer_group: 北京传统糕点伴手礼门店
results.evidence: 资料仅确认其为护国新天地商场内的现代糕点门店，‘宫廷糕点’属于店铺分类宣传，缺乏历史身份、建筑价值和文化展示证据。

items.en: Wenyu Cheese (Nanluoguxiang Branch) is a specific cheese-dessert shop on Nanluoguxiang. The Dianping photo page shows categories and price-list photos for items such as original-flavor cheese, double-skin milk, and milk rolls, but does not provide verifiable current menu, prices, or operating status. A Beijing tourism official page once recorded its address as No. 49 Nanluoguxiang and stated that the owner was “said to have learned from” Sanyuan Meiyuan, with sales limited daily; these are historical reports or hearsay and cannot replace on-site verification.

Fangzhuanchang No. 69 Zhajiangmian (Fangzhuanchang Hutong Branch) is a specific operating shop in Fangzhuanchang Hutong. The Dianping album page lists the shop address as No. 1 Fangzhuanchang Hutong and the per-person information as CNY 27; “No. 69” is part of the brand name, not the street number listed on that page. A Beijing tourism report stated that it had been recommended by the Michelin Guide for six consecutive years and included on a relevant consumption map, but this is reported information and cannot confirm current operation or the building’s history.

Jingxiu Restaurant (Nanluoguxiang Branch) is a specific dining establishment in the Nanluoguxiang area. The Ctrip merchant page lists the address as No. 36 Dongmianhua Hutong, Nanluoguxiang, and displays dishes such as Beijing cuisine, suiliu chicken, and boiled fish; the page also shows business hours and an “Open” status, but this is a platform snapshot and cannot represent current operation. A Beijing tourism report stated that it began in 1992 and was known as the “second cafeteria of the Central Academy of Drama”; here this is included only as a report on the shop’s history and does not imply that the existing building was built in 1992.

Beiping Garden · Chaowan Mengya · Beiping Coffee (Nanluoguxiang Hutong Branch) is a specific coffee and dining establishment presented under a combined name. The shop’s platform page lists coffee, waffles, pizza, pasta, desserts, and other items; the Ctrip page uses another combined name that includes a youth hostel and provides the address No. 113-2 Nanluoguxiang along with platform operating information. This entry only organizes dining information for the shop and does not expand to the youth hostel’s accommodation business.

Tangfang Coffee (Nanluoguxiang Branch) is a coffee shop in the Nanluoguxiang area. The Dianping page categorizes it under “Nanluoguxiang/Gulou East Street Coffee”; the snapshot shows a platform rating of 4.3 and an average per-person spending of CNY 48, and lists latte, iced Americano, specialty pour-over coffee, flat white, and other user-recommended drinks. Pizza, pasta, and desserts are also listed. The available sources support only the shop category, consumption snapshot, and recommended-dish information shown on the platform page, and cannot confirm current operation, a complete menu, prices, or the customer experience.

Jingshanzi (Nanluoguxiang Branch) is a specialty shop selling fans, and design reporting also described it as a space where fan enthusiasts could drink tea, converse, and discuss the appreciation of fans. A 2018 design article stated that it was located at No. 6 Nanluoguxiang and described various fans displayed in the shop, with wood finishes as the display background and display stands and cabinets designed to the scale of the fans. The available Dianping source only confirms the shop name and the existence of a photo page; the old design report reflects the space at that time and cannot replace verification of the current displays or operating status.

Yiduo Yiguo (Nanluoguxiang Branch) is a shop selling journaling and stationery items, postcards, and related goods. An industry shop-visiting article described a Nanluoguxiang shop as a “journaling laboratory,” introducing its tapes, pens, notebooks, stamps, journaling decorations, and some cartoon merchandise, and mentioning on-site making experiences. The platform page records another branch address as No. 45 Nanluoguxiang, while an index excerpt also shows No. 41 Nanluoguxiang. Since the same brand has two shops on Nanluoguxiang, this entry does not combine goods or experiences associated with different street numbers.

Jiaque'er Handcrafted Cultural-Creative Shop (Nanluoguxiang), according to a Beijing culture and tourism report from March 2026, is a newly opened distinctive street-front shop on Nanluoguxiang. The report describes it as a handcrafted cultural-creative shop and mentions a cement-gray façade, as well as handmade ceramic bottles, wooden animal ornaments, hand-painted gourd pendants, and other goods; it also records visitors’ interest in purchasing items while browsing the shop. The source does not provide a complete street number, business hours, prices, or information on continued operation, so all these details require on-site verification.

Qingsong Zaowu (Nanluoguxiang Designer Co-creation Space) was introduced in a Beijing culture and tourism report from March 2026 as a small young-person-run shop and designer co-creation space. The report lists cultural-creative products in the space, including ceramics, paper cuttings, stamps, and hand-painted gourd pendants, and states that visitors select goods in the shop. The available materials only describe the goods and spatial positioning presented at the time of the report; they cannot confirm current operation, stock, prices, or whether handmade courses are offered, nor can they imply that all goods have intangible cultural heritage certification.

Chocolate Player (Nanluoguxiang) is a young-person-run shop featured in a Beijing culture and tourism report from March 2026. The report focuses on its creative products: chocolate models of the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests at the Temple of Heaven, the Great Wall, and other forms. It states that the models are lifelike and that visitors can smell chocolate when approaching them, finding this novel. The available source supports only the product description in that report; it does not support treating the models as originals of urban landmarks or cultural relics, and provides no specific street number, business hours, prices, or complete product list.

Kao Rou Ji Restaurant (Shichahai Branch) is a roast-meat restaurant near Yinding Bridge in Shichahai. An old article on the Beijing Tourism website stated that it was founded in the 28th year of the Daoguang reign of the Qing dynasty (1848), specializes in Beijing-style roast meat and halal stir-fried dishes, and that its roast-meat preparation technique had been recognized as Beijing intangible cultural heritage; the same page listed the address as No. 14 Qianhai East Bank, Di’anmenwai Street, Xicheng District. A 2023 Beijing Daily report also recorded its breakfast stall. The available sources concern the restaurant brand’s history, dining content, and a banquet-hall record at the same address, and cannot confirm that the current building is the original structure from 1848 or that the restaurant is currently operating.

Qingyunlou Restaurant (Shichahai Branch) is listed in a Dianping member album as a Beijing-cuisine restaurant in Houhai/Shichahai. The page records an average per-person spending of CNY 123 and the address as the second floor of Qingyunlou, No. 22 Qianhai East Bank, beside Yinding Bridge. Another Dianping photo page lists categories or names of dishes including stir-fried pork tenderloin, sizzling-plate roast meat, roast duck, and scallion-braised sea cucumber. The available sources are mainly platform merchant and photo indexes and provide no verifiable information on the shop’s history, the building’s date, or current operation.

Halal · Ya’er Liji · Hot Pot (Shichahai Branch) is a specific dining establishment listed on the Dianping platform. The page categorizes it under hot-pot restaurants and displays photo categories for the façade, main hall, scenic-view seating, private rooms, and other surroundings, as well as menu-, bill-, and price-related images. The page also lists user-uploaded image tags such as fresh tripe, freshly skewered mutton, hand-cut fresh hind leg of lamb, and Qianlong cabbage. A Shichahai culture and tourism report reposted by the Beijing municipal government describes Ya’er Liji as a restaurant adhering to traditional charcoal-fired copper-pot and clear-broth hot pot. The above information comes respectively from the platform merchant album and the culture and tourism report and cannot confirm current operation, a real-time menu, prices, or the dining experience.

Huguosi Snacks (Di’anmen Branch) is listed separately under this branch name on a Dianping platform member-album page. The page categorizes it under Beijing snacks and fast food and shows a per-person price snapshot of CNY 28. It also clearly marks the branch’s address information but provides no telephone number; more information on the surroundings, transportation, and promotions requires entering the merchant page. This entry organizes only the branch identity and snapshot information based on the platform index. Since a complete real-time menu for this branch was not obtained, dishes, history, and operating conditions of the Huguosi main branch, Xinjiekou Branch, or other branches are not transferred to this branch.

Da Qing Postal Letter Cabinet (Shichahai Post Office) is a themed post-office branch at No. 53 Yandai Xiejie. Government reporting records that its predecessor belonged to the Shichahai Post and Telecommunications Office of the Di’anmen Post Office and that it opened under the name “Da Qing Postal Letter Cabinet” in 2011; a 2021 report stated that it reopened after renovation and upgrading. The reported contents inside include exhibitions of Large Dragon stamps, Coiling Dragon stamps, and Ferral’s manuscripts, as well as a postcard experience using an antique letterpress printing machine and the sale of postal products and postcards. The report also explains that the name was created to support the cultural presentation of Yandai Xiejie and cannot establish that it is an originally built Qing-dynasty post office.

Fuhuazhai Bobo Pastry Shop (Huguo Xintiandi Branch) appears as an independent branch name in the Dianping search index. The page labels it as a “palace-style pastries · gifts” merchant and shows a per-person price snapshot of CNY 56. The index also identifies the shop as a street-front commercial unit on the first floor of Huguo Xintiandi shopping mall. The materials obtained at present consist only of a Dianping index excerpt, without detailed text, a real-time menu, business hours, or historical information. Therefore, only the platform branch listing can be confirmed; “palace-style pastries” cannot be treated as an authenticated historical identity, nor can current operation on the day be inferred.

组内唯一对象，作为康熙御笔榜书与碑刻实物兼具皇家题刻、独特字形寓意和恭王府花园核心文化标识，代表性最高。
组内唯一对象，兼具恭王府花园制高点、太湖石叠山、秘云洞及康熙御笔“福”字碑等复合代表性，因而品质与非重复性均居高位。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府花园入口兼具孤赏石、影壁与屏风功能，形制和题字趣味突出，代表性最高。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府花园整体代表清代王府园林与府邸互补的完整叙事环节，独特性与补位价值均高。
组内唯一对象，作为恭王府花园中具有蝙蝠形制与“福钱”寓意的水体节点，独特性高但品质与叙事补位属局部。
组内唯一对象，作为万宁桥现存组合镇水石刻中明确可认定的一件元代石雕，具有较高的桥梁附属石刻代表性与叙事补位价值。
组内唯一对象，且为北京现存保存最完整并开放参观的清代王府及花园整体，在清代王府建筑、府园格局与晚清历史叙事中均具不可替代的代表性。
组内代表性最高：兼具清代王府完整格局、溥仪出生这一重大历史节点及宋庆龄故居的时代叠加，独特性最强。
组内代表性第二：府址规模大、跨多条胡同且与僧格林沁相关，南锣鼓巷王府叙事中的辨识度较高。
组内代表性第三：保存较完整的西部生活区有价值，但主体拆改且历史定位与醇、恭等王府相比更具重复性。
组内代表性最低：兼有愉王府旧址和涛贝勒府沿革，但拆改严重、现存格局不完整，独特补位价值弱于组内其他三项。
组内唯一对象，兼具西海湿地生态景观与元代大运河北端码头、郭守敬纪念关联，代表性与非重复性最高。
组内唯一的王府附属祠堂遗址，且祠堂与王府同胡同的布局被称为北京孤例，代表性和非重复性最高；但现存状况与开放性未明，叙事补位价值中上。
组内唯一对象，作为吴良镛主持的胡同有机更新代表项目，在现代遗产与居住型城市更新叙事中具有最高且不可替代的代表性。
组内唯一对象，作为蒋介石北平行辕这一近代政治人物历史旧址节点，代表性和非重复性最高，并补足北平政局与国共历史叙事。
组内唯一的近代高等教育旧址，兼具中西合璧校园建筑、天主教办学与高校制度变迁价值，代表性最高且无同类重复。
组内唯一的邮政主题文化体验节点，虽为现代主题邮局而非清代原址或原建邮局，但在本馆邮政互动体验叙事中具有不可替代性。
组内唯一对象，兼具中轴线北端标志性建筑群、元明清报时中心与钟鼓实物等复合代表性，因而三项均取高分。
组内综合代表性居次：虽为北京中轴线北端标志性报时楼阁且保留鼓楼报时传统，但相较钟楼的永乐大钟，其独特实物识别度略弱。
组内首位：现存清代砖石钟楼与永乐年制、重约63吨的古铜钟构成不可替代的报时遗产组合，在建筑群及中轴线叙事中最具代表性。
组内代表性最高：明永乐原铸、体量与历史地位突出，是北京传统报时体系中不可替代的核心实物。
组内次位：仅存一面原主鼓且其余为复制品，实物完整性和独特性低于永乐铜钟，但能补足鼓楼报时体系的另一端。
组内代表性最高，作为南锣鼓巷长期标志性甜品门店，对老北京街区消费记忆的补位最强。
组内居中，巧克力制作北京地标的当代创意较独特，但历史与品质代表性不及文宇奶酪。
组内代表性最低，虽可补充护国寺周边糕点伴手礼节点，但现有资料不足且门店类型与同组对象重复度较高。

S：恭王府及花园是保存完整的清代王府整体，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，整体消失会显著削弱本区域的清代王府识别度。
S：钟鼓楼整体是中轴线北端及古都报时制度的标志，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，建筑群消失会明显损害馆区身份。
S：鼓楼本身是北京标志性建筑，短访仍值得安排，错过会明显可惜；但钟楼及钟鼓楼整体仍在，单体并非唯一身份支点。

S：明永乐报时铜钟体量、年代和历史功能均极为独特，短访参观钟楼时应确保看到；错过明显可惜，失去这一标志性实物会明显损害钟楼的核心识别度。
S：花园是恭王府不可替代的一半，且具有独立完整的园林价值，短访仍应安排；错过明显可惜，花园消失会明显损害恭王府整体身份。

A：锡晋斋有精美构件和和珅史迹，但仍是府邸众多重要建筑中的一个；两小时内不属必须优先节点，错过不至于明显可惜，消失也不会单独改变恭王府身份。
S：滴翠岩制高点、秘云洞及康熙御笔福字碑构成花园的突出看点，短访仍应安排，错过明显可惜；但它只是花园中的一个节点，不能单独代表整体身份。

组内独特性仅次于梅兰芳纪念馆，以郭守敬的元代科学、天文历法和城市水利叙事补足其他故居没有的文明环节。

组内位居前列，以郭沫若晚年文学史学活动、故居原状陈列及恭王府相关地产沿革构成独立叙事。
组内属于较强代表，齐白石晚年创作与复原居所使其成为艺术家故居中较完整的艺术生活节点。
组内中上位置，茅盾故居保存原状空间和生活文献，能补充现代文学史叙事，但与其他作家故居存在一定类型重复。
组内中位偏上，婉容故居以末代皇后娘家和清末宫廷关联见长，但主要可见外部与院门，代表性受参观形态限制。
组内中下位置，萧军故居提供新文学与后海居住变迁的补充，但小楼已搬空且与作家故居类型重复。
组内普通历史宅院节点，洪承畴宅的历史人物标签较醒目，但缺少建筑保存与开放信息，代表性低于可进入的纪念馆。
组内较后位置，奎俊宅仅能补充清代官员宅第线索，现状与展示价值不明，重复性高于前列故居。
组内靠后，荣禄宅及近代建筑具有清代官邸与近代居住转型线索，但对象边界和保存状况不清，难作核心代表。
组内代表性最低，索家宅院目前主要只有历史宅主归属信息，与其他未开放官员宅院高度重复，叙事补位有限。

response.assessment:
本轮审查基于给出的变更代码、测试与样本数据（静态比对，未执行真实测试套件、未做真机验收、尚未部署）。核心契约基本自洽：
- 100条数据的身份、描述、评级与审计标记在 tour_collection_build.py 的多重 sha256/覆盖校验下保持一致；按提供的 all_records 样本手工核对 S/A/B/C 计数（8/32/35/25）与 test_every_audited_record_keeps_its_identity_description_and_rating 的断言完全吻合，未发现资料遗漏或身份错配的证据。
- 郭沫若故居（seq 48，identity=guomoruo）展示名称、关联整体、来源说明均与要求一致，未与恭王府混淆。
- 16家商铺的地址/特色/平台字段均以"来源记载""平台参考"等限定语言呈现，且前端 stopHtml 明确用独立标签展示，未与官方核实信息混同；方砖厂（86号1号门牌）、糖房咖啡（89号门牌遮挡）等边界样本与测试断言一致。
- 复核提示（锡晋斋/平复帖，seq 76）在数据、前端 note 文案、搜索关键词、AI问答材料四处均保留且可检索，未被误删。
- collection 模式下 routes=[]、default_route='none'、无 proj/canvas/area/entrance 字段，前端对 isCollection() 做了分支短路，避免了 buildMap/layout/startGeo/HOST.ready 等依赖几何或路线字段的函数被调用，静态分析未发现"无路线/无图"路径下的必然崩溃点；node 测试脚本中新增的 collection/collection_host 场景覆盖了搜索、筛选、详情、返回首页、以及"地图↔清单"切换时原生 ready/leave 状态的回归检查。
- 原生缓存同步逻辑（web_api/tour/app.js loadAll）已按"只同步有真实几何的目的地"过滤 collection 条目后再调用 HOST.catalog()，与 HostBridge.kt/TourData.kt 的几何解析要求兼容，catalog.json 中的三馆配置与此一致。

综合来看，四项important均有具体、可追溯证据支持其修复落地，且修复彼此之间及与此前已审的60图/16商铺/标签部分无冲突、未见引入新的回归点（UI端"同站往返"标注、地图bounds居中、停留/步行细分摘要等既有功能在当前UI代码中均保持原状、未受本轮改动破坏）。

findings.reason: 新增“线路图”主题切换使用独立状态 st.themeId，但点击事件处理中，选择主题 chip（data-map-theme）的分支只设置 st.themeId，并不清除原有路线选择（st.routeId，由 data-route 分支设置）；反过来，点击普通路线 chip 的既有分支也没有被修改为清除 st.themeId。结果是 themeSelection() 与 route() 可以同时为真：updateSpots() 中 `if (r || themed)` 会把来自 r（固定游览路线序号）与来自 themed.theme.steps（主题线路序号）的 ords 合并进同一个数组再拼接显示（如 '2–7'），导致地图图钉上出现两套互不相关顺序混合后的错误编号；同时 updateHUD 里 `$("route-summary")`/`$("route-detail-body")` 会先按 r 设值后又被 themed 覆盖，表现为点击切换时地图概览与图钉编号不一致。只要用户先点一个“全部景点”下的固定路线 chip，再点任一主题 chip（或反过来），就会复现。
findings.recommendation: 在两个点击分支中互斥清空对方状态，例如选择 data-map-theme 时同时清空 st.routeId（并调用 stopTour()/等效复位逻辑），选择 data-route 时同时清空 st.themeId；或者让 themeSelection() 与 route() 在读取时就互斥（谁最近被设置谁生效，并把另一个置空），避免 updateSpots 中 ords 被两套序号同时写入。

response.assessment: 除上述一项地图UI回归缺陷外，本轮新增内容未见明显实质性问题：SVG 生成脚本（generate_itinerary_maps.py）中坐标投影（project→xy 两段变换）、路径/标签与站点标记的坐标空间保持一致，箭头、比例尺、图例换行、S/E 标注逻辑在给定数据范围内自洽，--check 模式对 SVG 内容与 PNG 哈希的核验逻辑完整，不会把旧栅格图冒充为当前图；栅格化脚本（tour_itinerary_maps.mjs）对 SVG 哈希、页面加载完成状态、视口尺寸的处理与生成脚本保持一致，没有发现会产生错误 PNG 的逻辑漏洞。index.html/app.css 的改动仅为文案与样式调整，未发现回归。身份顺序（数字=游览顺序、点位=steps.point 公共参考点而非入口）、来源与距离/时长字段均未被此次改动触碰，也没有被重新计算或篡改，符合“只新增 map_assets 路径”的描述。建议先修复 app.js 中主题/路线状态互斥的问题，再进入完整浏览器场景回归。

原跨类型序号冲突意见复核：当前三个景区的数据模式互斥（wmhg/wanping 仅有 routes、无 itineraries；nanluo_shichahai 仅有 itineraries、无 routes），加之 openMuseum 切换景区会整体重建 st 且 themeId 置空，故在当前数据下 route() 与 themeSelection() 本就不可能同时为真，原意见所述“先点普通路线再点主题”的跨类型序号混合缺陷在当前版本确实不可复现，首轮判断准确。

本轮按建议新增的状态互斥仍是正确且具防御性的改动：collection-themes 面板与 chips 容器中的两处 data-theme-map/data-map-theme 分支对称地先置 st.routeId='none' 再设 st.themeId，并统一经由 collectionView(true)→stopTour()+buildMap()+updateRoute() 落地；chips 的 data-route 分支则先 stopTour()、清空 tourIdx，并在 st.themeId 为真时清空 themeId、重建底图（buildMap+layout），再设 st.routeId、save、updateRoute。route() 对 'none' 不会匹配到任何 M.routes 项，themeSelection() 依赖 st.themeId 为 null 时直接短路返回 null，因此 updateSpots/updateRoute 中 `r` 与 `themed` 不会再同时为真，原推荐的互斥语义已正确落地，对现有行为（单一类型内的路线/主题切换、collectionView 的视图复位、list/map 按钮状态）未见回归。

两项显示修正核验一致：地图标注 addLabel 对主题线路起终点统一缩短为 S / E（环线合并为 S/E），避免边缘截断；route-detail-body 中对应展示完整的 “S起点：…；E终点：…” 站名文本，二者数据来源同为 themed.variant 的 start_station/end_station，经 stationName() 从 M.itinerary_stations 取 name 字段，图上简写与详情全称指向同一站点，未发现不一致。环线（start_station===end_station）详情文案会重复展示同一站名两次，属于信息冗余但非错误，不影响判断。

结论：首轮意见判断准确（现无可复现场景），本轮按建议完成的状态互斥与两项显示修正逻辑自洽、相互一致，未发现新增问题。本次复核仅覆盖该状态互斥闭环及 S/E 显示逻辑，未重审16图生成器或历史资料部分。
